Save Share X (twitter.com) Facebook Mail Ballot Box 2026 Election Hub Your ballot, voting information and the latest updates Right Early voting for this year’s midterm election continues to hit a record high in Minnesota. The Minnesota Secretary of State’s Office reported more than 1,004,125 ballots cast through 3 p.m. Tuesday. 
 Of the early ballots cast, 298,998 were by mail and 705,127 were cast in person.
 Minnesota polls close Tuesday night at 8 p.m.
